يعتبروا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَبِرُوا (yaʕtabirū) /jaʕ.ta.bi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# يُعْتَبَرُوا (yuʕtabarū) /juʕ.ta.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
